name: floppy
title: Floppy
description: Turn any file into a share link and see who read it. Search your Floppy Disk, share the Finder selection, copy your last link.
author: lamine-c8

commands.name: search-floppy
commands.title: Search Floppy
commands.subtitle: Floppy
commands.description: Search the files on your Floppy Disk and copy their links, open them or show them in Finder.

commands.name: share-file
commands.title: Share File
commands.subtitle: Floppy
commands.description: Turn a file into a fpy.sh link, optionally for one named person, and copy it.

commands.name: share-finder-selection
commands.title: Share Finder Selection
commands.subtitle: Floppy
commands.description: Turn the files selected in Finder into one fpy.sh link and copy it.

commands.name: recent-links
commands.title: Recent Links
commands.subtitle: Floppy
commands.description: Your newest links with their views, and who read each one.

commands.name: copy-last-link
commands.title: Copy Last Link
commands.subtitle: Floppy
commands.description: Copy the link you made most recently.

commands.name: ask-floppy
commands.title: Ask Floppy
commands.subtitle: Floppy
commands.description: Ask a question about the text files on your Floppy Disk. Answered by Raycast AI on your Raycast plan.

tools.name: search-files
tools.title: Search Files
tools.description: Find files on the user's Floppy Disk by name or folder and get their fpy.sh links.

tools.name: list-recent-links
tools.title: List Recent Links
tools.description: List the user's newest Floppy links with their view counts.

tools.name: get-link-readers
tools.title: Get Link Readers
tools.description: See who read one Floppy link: each person's pages, reading time and last visit.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Optional. A Floppy API key from fpy.sh/app/keys. Leave it empty to sign in with your Floppy account in the browser.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
